name: MUSDB18 Music Source Separation Benchmark
description: A music source separation benchmark built from multitrack music recordings, commonly used to evaluate separation of vocals, drums, bass, and other instruments from a mixed audio track.
evaluation_method: SDR/SIR/SAR improvement, typically via source separation metrics such as museval or BSS Eval
typical_sota_score: state-of-the-art systems often exceed prior baselines by several dB SDR on common stems, though exact results depend on split and evaluation protocol
notes: This is a standard benchmark for music source separation research. Performance is strongly affected by mixture complexity, phase modeling, and training data scale.
